basic.keyboard-input.description: Listens to passive physical keyboard events (Windows Raw Input) or emits test text on manual trigger.

out.label: Key / Text
out.description: Emits the pressed character or key name inside a message basket.

captureGlobal.label: Capture Keyboard
captureGlobal.description: Observe physical Windows keyboard events passively without blocking input.

printableOnly.label: Printable Only
printableOnly.description: Emit only printable characters (letters, digits, punctuation). Uncheck to include Shift, Enter, F-keys, etc.

filterKey.label: Key Filter
filterKey.description: Optional comma-separated key names to match; leave empty to capture all keys.
filterKey.placeholder: All keys (or e.g. A, Space, F9)

testText.label: Manual Payload
testText.description: Payload emitted when clicking the manual trigger button on this node.

basic.keyboard-output.description: Types incoming text into the currently focused Windows window via SendInput (Unicode). Tagged so it will not loop back into Keyboard Input.

in.label: Text
in.description: Text payload to type into the active window.

active.label: Active (Send)
active.description: Uncheck to mute output safely without disconnecting the wire.

delayMs.label: Delay (ms)
delayMs.description: Optional delay in milliseconds (0–5000) before typing.

basic.to-upper.description: Converts incoming message string payload to UPPERCASE while preserving the rest of the data basket.

trim.label: Trim Whitespace
trim.description: Remove leading and trailing whitespace before converting to uppercase.

prefix.label: Prefix
prefix.description: Optional text prepended before the uppercased payload.

suffix.label: Suffix
suffix.description: Optional text appended after the uppercased payload.

basic.debug.description: Inspects messages traveling along wires and streams them to the Debug panel. Also passes the message through.

out.label: Pass-through
out.description: Optional pass-through so Debug can be placed inline on a wire.

active.label: Active
active.description: Enable or mute output to the Debug sidebar.

label.label: Tag
label.description: Optional label shown next to entries in the Debug panel.

fullBasket.label: Full Basket
fullBasket.description: Show full message basket (payload, topic, properties, meta) or payload only.
